$Comment: Martha's Golden Plate, the year's keepsake: Martha hands one over with the pay for The Feast, once each Harvest Feast, and it is never sold or crafted. It places like the game's own plate (Deco_Plate), on that plate's model, and stacks on another the same way, so a player can pile up one for every year. Its texture and icon are a gold recolour of the game's plate texture and icon, written by tools/derive_art.py (change the GOLD_RAMP there and rerun it, never the PNGs). The quest's Claim row stamps each one with the year (StackNameKey keepsake.harvest_feast_golden_plate.name in harvestfeast.progression.lang), so the name here is the plain one a list or a tooltip shows. Its words are in items.lang.
